description:
Welcome to Recap Runic — the home of cinematic, lore-accurate Manhwa & Webtoon storytelling.

We craft deep-dive recaps, arc sagas, and full-season movies for fans who love high-tier regression, overpowered tactical protagonists, and complex system awakenings.

🛡️ THE RECAP RUNIC STANDARD (ZERO SLOP):
• Clean RPG Math & Consistent Progression (No arbitrary stat bloat)
• High-Tactical Combat Realism (Elevation, choke-points, and spatial strategy)
• High-IQ Antagonists & Political Leverage (No brain-rot excuses or cartoonish villains)
• Same-Act Forensic Lore & Full-Arc Continuity

🎬 OUR PRODUCTION FORMATS:
• Weekly Episodes (18–25 Mins) — Rapid algorithmic chapters & episodic hooks

🔔 Upload Schedule: Weekly uploads + Monthly Mega-Marathons.
